review_method: Fresh visual inspection of retained original map pixels, credits, successful acquisition receipt and official discovery capture. Every selected source and baseline-rendered polygon part and ring was viewed in full. All ordered positions, bounds and closure were independently recomputed from the original retained source collection and selected decoded baseline. Regional position, orientation, complete outline, direct labels and connections were considered together; neither bounds nor label overlap alone established identity. The packed decoder was not independently replayed. Independent observations were recorded before reading the source researcher draft extracts; a brief status summary arrived after visual inspection.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.

Exact extent and product-name application are not approved.
limits: Fine northwest arm and bay tips, island holes, irregular shore margins and the River Bay/connecting-river boundary are generalized or omitted; the entire detailed named lake is not certified.

Little Togiak Lake, Lake Beverly, Lynx Lake and Lake Aleknagik are separately mapped waters outside this selected ring; northwest arm and River Bay are component context, not alternative whole-lake names.
